ns2:section.sectionText: Enrollment restricted to current actuarial science majors April 3 - April 20. Class will be unrestricted during business hours the morning of April 21, 2017. Prospective transfers should review http://www.math.illinois.edu/ActuarialScience/transfer-to-actsci-ui-only.pdf Prospective transfers who are not able to register on April 21 should fill out the form here by August 24 to be added to the request list: http://go.illinois.edu/MATH210FA17 After August 24, please sent name, netid, 9-digit UIN, and reason for request to mathadvising@illinois.edu.
